name: plan-link-retired
body: `apg plan link` retires. Its Satisfies/Gates set-semantics fold into `apg plan update <project> phase <n> --satisfies … --prereq …`, which reuses `link_phase_edges` (src/plan_cmd.rs:591) and `push_gate`'s cycle check. Acceptance: `apg plan link` is removed from dispatch/help; the equivalent update-phase invocation produces the same Satisfies/Gates edges (set-semantics, cycle-refusing) that `link` produced.
